name: What are common signs that my mobile home needs foundation repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my mobile home needs foundation repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your mobile home may need foundation repair include uneven or sloping floors, cracks in interior or exterior walls, doors and windows that stick or don't close properly, and gaps forming around window or door frames. You might also notice separating skirting, visible cracks in the foundation itself, or issues with plumbing and utility lines due to shifting. Addressing these signs early can prevent more extensive damage and ensure the structural integrity of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of mobile home foundation issues include uneven floors, wall cracks, sticking doors/windows, and separating skirting.
